annotations.title: A ship's deck plans and cabins to avoid

description: For one cruise ship: its deck plan editions by sailing dates, with the PDF and the cruise line's own source, the cabin grades, and Cruises Frog's notes on quieter cabins and cabins to check or avoid (noise from pools, theaters, galleys above or below), with the deck plan and cabins-to-avoid page links.
